messages.author: 09f73c72230543fe
messages.subject: Removing verticals from geom_step
parts:
Hi,

Is there a way to remove the verticals from geom_step in the same way
that plotting ecdfs with the default options work?

Like this:
x<-c(1,2,2,1,1,3,3,4,5,6,7,7,9,1,2,3,3,1,8,8)
plot(ecdf(x))

Thanks,

Osei

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: Removing verticals from geom_step
parts:
Hi,

probably no options to do it, but you can do it easily by yourself:

x<-c(1,2,2,1,1,3,3,4,5,6,7,7,9,1,2,3,3,1,8,8)

xx <- sort(unique(x))
df <- data.frame(x = xx, y = ecdf(x)(xx))

df2 <- stairstep(df)
df2 <- rbind(df2, c(Inf, max(df2$y)))
df2$g <- gl(nrow(df2)/2, 2) # group label for geom_line

ggplot(NULL, aes(x, y)) + geom_point(data = df) + geom_line(aes(group
= g), data = df2)


--
Kohske Takahashi <takahash...@gmail.com>

Research Center for Advanced Science and Technology,
The University of  Tokyo, Japan.
http://www.fennel.rcast.u-tokyo.ac.jp/profilee_ktakahashi.html
